adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Reject weak pack or isolate invalid siblings before official candidate handling.

adversarialCases.scenario: Candidate/pack/analysis metadata tries to set can_live, can_export, final promotion, or production-ready fields.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Strict validation rejects or blocks authority and smoke artifacts keep can_export/can_live/can_final_promote false.

adversarialCases.scenario: Fallback or generated condition uses R_/S_ diagnostic/result variables.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Expression leakage validation blocks execution; fallback receives prompt_score 0 and no prompt maturity credit.
